Class Paginator.Config<S extends Enum<S> & SortPropertyProvider>

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.jpa.spring.page.Paginator.Config<S>
Type Parameters:
S - the sort enum type
Enclosing class:
Paginator
public static final class Paginator.Config<S extends Enum<S> & SortPropertyProvider> extends Object
Settings for a Paginator, adjusted by the customizer passed to Paginator.of(Class, Class, Consumer). Each method returns this config for chaining; the settings are validated together when the paginator is built.

  • Method Details

    • tiebreaker

      public Paginator.Config<S> tiebreaker(String... properties)
      Sets the unique property (or properties, for a composite key) appended ascending as the final sort order. Defaults to "id". The properties together must be unique, or ties remain.
      Parameters:
      properties - JPA property paths, e.g. "identityId" or "order.id", "lineNo"
      Returns:
      this config
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if no property is given or any is blank

    • noTiebreaker

      public Paginator.Config<S> noTiebreaker()
      Disables the tiebreaker. Pages are then only stable when the requested sort is unique on its own.
      Returns:
      this config

    • skipPropertyValidation

      public Paginator.Config<S> skipPropertyValidation()
      Skips checking the sort and tiebreaker properties against the entity type. Use it only when the paged query does not sort by entity properties, e.g. a native query whose sort keys are column names.
      Returns:
      this config

    • defaultSort

      public Paginator.Config<S> defaultSort(S defaultSort)
      Sets the sort used when a request has no (or a blank) sortBy. The request's direction still applies.
      Parameters:
      defaultSort - the default sort
      Returns:
      this config

    • defaultPageSize

      public Paginator.Config<S> defaultPageSize(int defaultPageSize)
      Sets the page size used when a request has none. Defaults to 20.
      Parameters:
      defaultPageSize - the default page size; between 1 and the maximum
      Returns:
      this config

    • maxPageSize

      public Paginator.Config<S> maxPageSize(int maxPageSize)
      Sets the largest page size a request can produce. Defaults to 100.
      Parameters:
      maxPageSize - the maximum page size; at least the default page size
      Returns:
      this config
